Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) demonstrates a small right hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal/heart shift (dextroposition) and a characteristic curvilinear opacity in the right lower lung zone (indicated by the arrow), which represents the anomalous pulmonary vein of Scimitar syndrome. The CT images confirm right-sided vascular and parenchymal anomalies consistent with this congenital condition, often associated with right lung hypoplasia or lobar aplasia.
